metric.implemented: computed end to end; every field is have or derived
metric.defined: definition fixed; every field is have or derived; no computation yet
metric.needs_fields: definition fixed; at least one field is add or unavailable, so the number is not available

field.have: written by the current recorder (source v2) or the compact record
field.derived: computed reliably from fields that are have
field.add: planned F1 field of a later round; absent from every source today
field.unavailable: not visible to the player or not part of any upload; the metric stays unavailable

metrics.title: Win rate of Constructed and Arena games
metrics.unit: one game capture fit for outcome (one installation's observation)
metrics.denominator: games with end.result in W, L (ties are counted and shown separately, not in the denominator)
metrics.missing: a game without eligibility.outcome is left out of both counts; an unknown format is its own group
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner = hash of the install id) among its own games, else null; value null below 10 games in its denominator
metrics.display: B1: My Stats and the stats pages, beside the W/L/T counts

metrics.title: Share of tied games
metrics.unit: one game capture fit for outcome
metrics.denominator: games with end.result in W, L, T
metrics.display: B1: next to the win rate, never folded into it

metrics.title: Results by own class, deck and opponent class
metrics.unit: one game capture fit for outcome
metrics.numerator: games with end.result = W in the group
metrics.denominator: games with end.result in W, L in the group
metrics.missing: groups need class and deck in the source; old captures stay out of these groups

metrics.title: Game length in turns
metrics.unit: one game capture fit for outcome
metrics.numerator: sum of the highest observed game turn
metrics.missing: turns, not minutes: the source keeps no timestamps
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own games, else null; mean null below 10 games

metrics.title: Battlegrounds solo place: mean, distribution, first places, top 4
metrics.unit: one BG solo game capture fit for outcome
metrics.numerator: sum of places (mean); count per place 1..8 (distribution); place = 1; place <= 4
metrics.denominator: BG solo games fit for outcome
metrics.missing: games without eligibility.outcome are left out; Duos is a separate metric
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own games, else null; value and dist null below 10 games; Wilson interval for shares, mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n)

metrics.title: Duos team place 1..4
metrics.unit: one Duos game capture fit for outcome
metrics.numerator: sum of team places; count per place 1..4
metrics.missing: never mixed with solo; no top-4 share (meaningless with four teams)
metrics.display: B1: Battlegrounds stats card, Duos tab

metrics.title: Hero offered, picked, and place after the pick (BG solo)
metrics.unit: one BG solo game capture (one installation's observation); window start.day in [today - 30, today]
metrics.numerator: picked(h): captures fit for offers whose pick is h; placement: places of captures fit for offers and outcome whose pick is h
metrics.denominator: offered(h): captures fit for offers whose offer contains h (once per capture); placement.n(h): captures fit for offers and outcome whose pick is h
metrics.missing: options are those at the moment of the pick: heroes rerolled away are not in offered(h), so offer frequency of rerolled heroes is understated (a later metric); captures without eligibility.offers are left out of every count
metrics.smallSample: each number needs ANALYTICS_MIN_SOURCES (5) distinct installations (owner = hash of the install id) among the captures it is made of, else null: the hero row needs 5 installations it was offered to (else not listed, counted in suppressed); picked and pickRate need 5 installations that picked it; placement, top4 and first need 5 installations that picked it and have a place. Above that, a value with fewer than ANALYTICS_MIN_CELL (10) games in its denominator keeps num/den (n) but value/low/high (mean) and dist are null; a row with any null value is small_sample (docs/analytics-api.md)
metrics.statistics: pickRate = picked / offered and top4/first: Wilson interval, z = 1.96; mean place: mean +/- 1.96 s / sqrt(n), null when n < 2; dist[0..7] counts places 1..8
metrics.display: B1: hero card in the BG stats page (no screen in round 1)

metrics.title: Trinket offered and picked, and place after the pick
metrics.unit: one trinket offer in a BG game capture
metrics.missing: the source does not yet label which general choice is a trinket offer

metrics.title: Buys, sells and plays per game and per turn
metrics.unit: one BG game capture (actions are counted even in partial captures)
metrics.numerator: explicit local buy / sell / play actions
metrics.denominator: BG game captures (per turn: captures that reached the turn)
metrics.missing: a buy without a visible target is an action without a card; never a win rate of buys
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 captures

metrics.title: Share of shop offers bought, by turn and tavern tier
metrics.numerator: rolls in which card c was bought
metrics.missing: without the boundary of each roll the full offer cannot be told from a partial one
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 rolls

metrics.title: Discover offered and picked
metrics.missing: unresolved choices are left out; repeated alternatives are kept
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 choices

metrics.title: Refreshes, freezes and tavern upgrades per turn
metrics.numerator: explicit local refresh / freeze / upgrade actions
metrics.missing: counts only: action.cost is unavailable, and a change of gold is not taken for the price of an action
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 captures

metrics.title: Gold left at the end of the shop phase
metrics.unit: one shop phase of a BG game capture
metrics.numerator: sum of snapshot gold at the last snapshot before combat
metrics.denominator: shop phases with a known gold value
metrics.missing: without the shop/combat boundary the last shop snapshot is a guess
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; mean null below 10 phases

metrics.title: Combat W/T/L and damage by round
metrics.numerator: combats won / tied / lost; damage dealt or taken
metrics.denominator: finished observed combats of the round
metrics.missing: the source is not a replay of the displayed combat (combat_view); results need a visible combat record
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 combats

metrics.title: Simulator forecast against the actual combat
metrics.unit: one finished, observed combat with a forecast
metrics.numerator: combats whose outcome matched the forecast's most likely outcome
metrics.denominator: combats with a forecast and an observed result
metrics.missing: forecasts stay on the player's machine and are not uploaded; a forecast is never a result
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 combats

metrics.title: Place by final board composition
metrics.unit: one BG solo game capture fit for outcome
metrics.numerator: sum of places of games whose last visible board matches build b
metrics.denominator: games whose last visible board matches build b
metrics.missing: the final board shows survivors only and does not prove an early buy helped; lobby tribes are needed to compare builds
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 games

metrics.title: Arena draft card offered and picked
metrics.unit: one observed draft pick (normal and Underground separately)
metrics.missing: draft captures are partial (live offers not screen-verified); an unknown Arena kind is its own group
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 offers

metrics.title: Arena run wins and the draft that led to them
metrics.missing: games of one run are not independent draft observations; needs a run key and the redraft revision
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 runs

metrics.title: Offered, kept, replaced and received after the mulligan, and the game result
metrics.unit: one card instance in an opening hand
metrics.numerator: instances kept (keep rate); games won with the card kept (win rate when kept)
metrics.denominator: instances offered; games where the card was kept
metrics.missing: the opening hand and the hand after the swap are different facts; an unclear card move is not a confirmed swap
metrics.smallSample: every number needs at least 5 installations (owner) among its own observations, else null; value null below 10 games

fieldMatrix.source: source start.build (v1, v2); null is the unknown group
source v2 start.arena from GT_UNDERGROUND_ARENA / ArenaDraftOffer.Underground
source end.result from the local PLAYSTATE
source end.placement from the local hero's PLAYER_LEADERBOARD_PLACE
source v2 choice.choiceType from the ChoiceType of the entity choice
source choice.options, ordered, repeats kept, at each visible change
source choice.sourceCard when the source card is visible
planned: which general choice is a trinket offer, a quest or a discover
source turn of each record and TURN tags
source action.cost is always null: the price is not visible as a separate value
source snapshot cards with side shop
source snapshot cards with side local, zone PLAY
planned: boundary of each shop roll
planned: result of the displayed combat
planned: damage of the displayed combat
planned: lobby tribes (public at game start)
planned: normalised key of the own deck list (no deck name, no deck id)
planned: draft revision after a redraft
planned: cards received after the swap
